publications.title: AgriIR: A Scalable Framework for Domain-Specific Knowledge Retrieval
publications.venueLong: European Conference on Information Retrieval (ECIR 2026), Springer LNCS
publications.summary: A configurable six-stage retrieval-augmented generation framework for agricultural questions, with deterministic citations, released with a 15,247-entry open dataset.

publications.title: SycoLex: A Cross-Jurisdictional Benchmark for Detecting Sycophancy in Legal Case Reasoning
publications.summary: 1,954 legal cases from the US Supreme Court, the Supreme Court of India and Indian consumer courts, six sycophancy-inducing prompt variants, responses from five LLMs, and LLM-as-judge plus human-expert annotations. The evaluation data for the FIRE 2026 shared task.

publications.title: Hierarchical Opinion Classification using Large Language Models
publications.venueLong: Forum for Information Retrieval Evaluation (FIRE 2025), CEUR-WS vol. 4173
publications.summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of Gemma with a two-layer classification head and class-weighted loss; three-level opinion labels recast as an eight-class flat scheme.

publications.title: IISERK@ToT_2024: Query Reformulation and Layered Retrieval for Tip-of-Tongue Items
publications.note: Joint first authors: Shuvam Banerji Seal and Subinay Adhikary.
publications.summary: Known-item search for half-remembered books and films: four-step LLM query reformulation followed by two-layer BM25 retrieval, reaching recall@1000 of 0.8067.

publications.title: Computational Modelling of [VO(SALIEP)(DTP)] as a Water-Reducing Catalyst
publications.summary: DFT (B3LYP, Gaussian) study of a vanadium complex: molecular-orbital energies, electronic structure and reaction pathways for water reduction.

thesis.title: Gray-code and Karnaugh-map structure of nucleic-acid and protein sequences, formalised in Lean 4
thesis.summary: Encoding DNA, RNA and protein sequences as binary codewords on Gray-code orderings and Karnaugh maps, so that neighbours in the map differ by one mutation, with every theorem machine-checked in Lean 4 and Mathlib.

thesis.title: A transformer mixture-of-experts model for RNA structure prediction
thesis.summary: A sparse mixture-of-experts transformer for RNA secondary and tertiary structure, with experts routed by structural motif, trained with distributed mixed-precision training.

datasets.name: SycoLex
datasets.summary: Sycophancy in legal case reasoning: 1,954 cases, three jurisdictions, CC-BY-4.0.

datasets.name: AgriIR_dataset
datasets.summary: 15,247 curated Indian agricultural knowledge entries with quality scores, CC-BY-4.0.
